parameters.name: All
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to remove all tags. Valid values:

- **true**: Yes.
- **false**: No.

The default value is **false**.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The IDs of the resources. You can specify from **1** to **50** resource IDs.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The type of the resource. The value must be **DOMAIN**.

parameters.name: TagKey
parameters.description: The keys of the tags to remove. You can specify from **1** to **20** tag keys.
